import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        raise ValueError("input df is not a DataFrame")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    # Exclude all rows whose name appears more than once
    if "name" in df.columns:
        filtered_df = df.loc[~df["name"].duplicated(keep=False)].copy()
    else:
        filtered_df = df.copy()

    # Keep only usable numeric age/score values
    if "age" in filtered_df.columns and "score" in filtered_df.columns:
        data = filtered_df[["age", "score"]].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").dropna()
        x = data["age"]
        y = data["score"]

        ax.scatter(x, y)

        # Plot regression line when possible
        if len(data) >= 2 and x.nunique() >= 2:
            try:
                slope, intercept, _, _, _ = stats.linregress(x, y)
                x_line = [x.min(), x.max()]
                y_line = [intercept + slope * xv for xv in x_line]
                ax.plot(x_line, y_line)
            except Exception:
                pass

    ax.set_title("Linear Regression")
    ax.set_xlabel("Age")
    ax.set_ylabel("Score")

    return plt, ax
